note: Every claim in the owning record maps to a named executed check with retained bytes, or is declared not_covered. A not_covered declaration does NOT silence this gate; it names the gap and still fails. Retained bytes must show the named check PASSING, so a mapping cannot be satisfied by a check that never ran.
retained_bytes_provenance: Gate bytes are produced by fresh detached processes in a dedicated detached worktree at the exact commit under review. A working-tree run is not admissible evidence: a gate green in a working tree can be green on uncommitted bytes. Retained bytes must declare IOI_MEASURED_COMMIT. The declared commit is accepted when it equals the packet HEAD, or when it is an ANCESTOR of HEAD whose entire measured-to-HEAD delta is retained evidence. Both clauses bind: tree equality is not history, so a non-ancestor (or a commit ahead of HEAD) with an evidence-only tree diff is refused.

claim_coverage.check_name: a lease SURVIVES RESTART with its admitted state intact
claim_coverage.why: F2 CLOSED. Proven against a genuinely restarted daemon over the same data directory rather than argued as true-by-construction: the lease's admitted state and acknowledged checkpoint are intact after restart, and the stream reconstructs its exact accepted head. Fails closed if the restart plane is unavailable, so an absent plane cannot read as coverage.

claim_coverage.why: F2 CLOSED. The second owner namespace now admits, is REPLAYED through delivery, and SERVES a leased subscription -- create, read, checkpoint advance, revoke, expiry and resume all run under automation-scheduler, the non-thread-orchestration owner. Genericity is proven by the second customer rather than assumed from the first.

claim_coverage.check_name: delivery under a REVOKED lease refuses by name rather than returning empty
claim_coverage.why: F2 and F3 CLOSED. Each named fault now has a typed outcome proven live: unleased/revoked delivery refuses by name, expiry refuses by name, checkpoint substitution refuses, a rewinding checkpoint refuses, lag resolves to a bounded typed outcome instead of a silent drop, and restart is proven by the restart assertions. 'Delivered nothing' and 'may not deliver' are distinguishable facts.

claim_coverage.check_name: an ephemeral append on a COLD (restarted) daemon performs ZERO history walks
claim_coverage.why: Codex P0 and its restart recurrence, closed. The claim is ABSOLUTE -- an ephemeral delivery performs zero substrate traversals -- so it is now backed by the COLD-restart probe rather than the warm-cache one. The previous 7/7 was FALSE: an absolute claim was mapped to a conditional probe that only ever measured a warm process, and Codex measured history_walks 0 -> 1 on the first ephemeral append after a restart. The declaration projection is rebuilt at steward open, which the daemon forces at boot; open-time fills are counted separately from delivery-time walks so the two cannot be conflated. Proven red by removing boot hydration.
